New Launch | Astra Fund (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VWMbj385-lVBW3gRpZ32fcTlpW2jjqKJ5X1S8qN5_C1nF3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3pTW3gslvB72-ZG8W9kmFDB12gsHCW12Kfk84KGh6tW340F4-2VF3PRW4x7hQS6LPgQnN10Zld8R7Ps2W2HzPQg3tR201W4V3T_612-RsrW892Hs-56dZSHV2sBVw2wV167W34Pznm1VgJcDW496BH76ZqK3VW3NT7mj5NYT3fW6zBFMT2RFqx4VtCZGV25wHTRW8K2Jts6K636WW6X09By1TjxldW6GBVSc5q4TNJV6yyW797FLN-W5PY4kp5rk9jrW6Qk5X07qWGLFW81Q7M03v8f-lW2GQ15L6BL5k_W4h2dR46pfPKRW8jSMkr6rgQ9VW6_wfwN2s6qKnV8FTZF34J7-LW8fbNq_616NvJf4RpnJP04 )

Hi Oleg,

Astra Fund is now open, offering exposure to five private companies across space, AI cloud, quantum computing, AI productivity, and blockchain.1

The Fund’s largest allocation is Blue Origin (36.10%, assuming a fully subscribed offering), the space company Jeff Bezos founded in 2000 and funded himself for its first 25 years.2

In September 2026, Blue Origin secured roughly $10B in its first external financing at an estimated post-money valuation of about $140B, led by Coatue Management. In April 2025, the U.S. Space Force awarded Blue Origin nearly $2.4B for seven missions under National Security Space Launch Phase 3, Lane 2.2

Here’s what else is inside:

- Together AI (29.40%): An open-source AI cloud used by companies like Cursor, Salesforce, and The Washington Post. In July 2026, it announced an $800M Series C at an $8.30B post-money valuation, led by Aramco Ventures. In August 2026, it announced a multi-year, $240M agreement with IBM to run open-source AI inference on IBM Cloud.3
- PsiQuantum (21.53%): A photonic quantum computer targeting utility-scale systems of a million-plus qubits, backed by BlackRock, NVIDIA, Baillie Gifford, and Microsoft’s venture fund. In October 2026, it received a conditional commitment for a loan of up to $150M from the U.S. Department of War’s Office of Strategic Capital.4
- Superhuman (fka Grammarly) (10.66%): An AI productivity suite that includes Grammarly, Coda, Mail, and Superhuman Go. As of September 2025, over 40M daily users and 96% of the Fortune 500 rely on Grammarly, and the company has surpassed $700M in annual revenue.5
- Consensys (2.31%): Founded by Ethereum co-founder Joseph Lubin, Consensys builds MetaMask, which, as of April 2026, counts more than 100M users annually. In September 2026, the company announced plans to split MetaMask into its own company.6

Exposure to Blue Origin and Together AI is held indirectly via SPV interests.1

With Astra Fund, you can gain exposure to all five companies with one minimum of $49,992.48.

82014.subject: welcome to athletedata mcp
82014.body:
Hey Oleg,

Many thanks for signing up! We're Julian and Daniel and built the athletedata MCP server because we were tired of screenshotting our Garmin and WHOOP data into Claude every time we wanted to ask about our training.

Two steps to get going:

1. Connect your wearables and apps (Garmin, Strava, WHOOP, Apple Health, Google Calendar and many more)
2. Grab your API key and paste the MCP config into your favourite AI tool

Connect your apps: https://athletedata.health/dashboard/integrations

If anything's confusing or broken, just reply to this email - we personally read every reply.

Julian & Daniel

PS: You can also text your data. The trial includes our proactive coach on WhatsApp, Telegram or iMessage.

81932.subject: AVALANCHE OCTOBER 2026 RECAP
81932.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-october-2026-recap

October was the month Summit’s momentum turned into policy and capital. South Korea’s Financial Services Commission moved from exploring tokenization to publishing rules for it, institutions from Hyundai to Charles Schwab kept naming Avalanche directly, and Team1 Japan became Team1’s 10th global chapter.
Avalanche also launched Avalanche Originals, a new series taking viewers behind the scenes with the builders Summit introduced.
Here’s everything that happened in October.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Avalanche Leads All Chains in Tokenized Stock Growth:
Avalanche added more tokenized stock market cap than any other chain in September, up $245.5 million and led by Securitize. [Stock Growth [ https://substack.com/redirect/6cad1406-48b9-4a5c-9e93-231ebe85392a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Tokenized Treasuries Are Up 4x This Year:
Tokenized U.S. Treasuries on Avalanche climbed 14% in Q3 alone to $545 million, now four times where they started the year. [Treasuries [ https://substack.com/redirect/c05f9abb-8008-421c-b446-cd9992fd355c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Pharaoh Exchange Hits a Record Month:
Avalanche’s top DEX posted all-time high monthly volume and fees, coming right off announcing 24/7 permissionless stock trading. [Pharaoh [ https://substack.com/redirect/268cd9e9-907b-4258-aefc-d46af180ca1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Japan Becomes the 10th Global Chapter:
Team1 Japan officially launched after 30 events across four cities, 1,200 attendees, 18 Avalanche Gourmet Nights, and four institutional events, with the Foundation welcoming the milestone as proof of Japan’s growing institutional adoption.
Team1 Chapters Build Across the Globe:
Team1 chapters remained active globally this month. Türkiye held UniTour #3 across three cities and six universities before hosting its first hackathon with OKX Türkiye, attracting 60+ developers and 30 projects. Vietnam reached 250+ students through its VKU Uni Tour, hosted a She Build meetup and opened registration for a 420-builder UniHack. Africa held workshops in Zaria and Warri, Nigeria, and an Avalanche Academy session in Johannesburg. Thailand hosted its first Kasetsart University session, while first-ever meetups took place in Lviv and Shenzhen.
In the U.S., Team1 held a Blockchain x AI event during SF Tech Week and launched its weekly Team1 Break X Spaces. India partnered with India Blockchain Week ahead of its November 2 Mumbai Networking Gala, while Brazil announced a trading card meetup with YourGrails and NYC hosted a rooftop meetup with The Grotto.

80931.subject: Team1 Japan: Institutions Chose Avalanche. Now It’s the Builders’ Turn.
80931.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/team1-japan-institutions-chose-avalanche

Team1 Japan is officially here.
Our mission is to build a Japanese builder community that matches the scale of Japan’s institutional adoption.
Here is what that means, and why Japan’s builder scene is unique.
The sequence is backwards, and that’s the opportunity
Japan’s institutions have already made their choice.
Progmat, the platform behind the majority of the country’s security token issuance, moved billions in tokenized real estate and corporate bonds onto a dedicated Avalanche L1. TIS, which processes more than half of Japan’s credit card volume, also launched its own L1. Some of the largest names in Japanese finance are now exploring tokenized government bonds using Avalanche infrastructure.
In most countries, this runs the other way. A community forms, developers experiment, projects ship, and eventually, sometimes years later, institutions notice and follow. Japan skipped the first half.
The chains themselves stay controlled, as Japanese financial regulation requires, but they no longer sit behind a wall. Gateways outward to wallets, to stablecoin settlement, and to applications written by people who were never invited into a private consortium are now being built. Japan’s financial system is no longer a closed circuit. It is growing an edge you can build against.
The demand is real, and the gateways to these platforms are underway.
That’s the gap Team1 Japan is here to close.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
What is Team1?
Team1 is a network of builders, developers, creators, event organizers, and community leaders working to grow the Avalanche ecosystem from the ground up. Since launching in 2024, it has grown to hundreds of members across more than 40 countries, with official chapters now live in the USA, Vietnam, India, Türkiye, Brasil, and across LatAm.
Team1 Japan is the newest of those chapters.
Our mandate is focused: connect Japan’s builders to Avalanche, and connect them to each other.
This is a formalization, not a beginning
Japan’s Avalanche community has been meeting for years.
Since April 2023, over 30 events have been held across Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, and Fukuoka with more than 1200 attendees between them. The anchor is Avalanche Gourmet Night, a series running for over two years that marks the beginning of the Avalanche community’s in-person presence
The programming has widened past meetups. Avalanche Academy study sessions have run four times since March, giving developers a recurring technical space rather than a social one. There have been collaborations with Uniswap Labs, zeroone, and Pudgy Penguins, and a workshop for teams who entered the JPYC stablecoin innovation challenge.

80805.subject: More Trading, Different Activity: Avalanche’s Latest 30 Days
80805.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/more-trading-different-activity-avalanches

Nansen recorded 48.4 million transactions, down 33% from the previous 30 days. At the same time, DEX volume climbed to $2.7 billion, up 145%, while active users increased 8.1% to 1.6 million.
So Avalanche was not simply quieter. There were fewer transactions in Nansen’s dataset, but much more trading volume. Users still grew, capital continued moving through the ecosystem, and activity across individual Avalanche L1s adds another part of the picture.
Trading picked up fast
The biggest change is DEX volume. WAVAX alone accounted for around $2.5 billion, with roughly $1.3 billion in buys and $1.3 billion in sells.
Active users also moved higher, reaching around 1.6 million, up 8.1% from the previous period. If that user growth continues while transactions stabilize, this month may end up looking more like a change in how Avalanche is being used than a simple drop in activity.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
AVAX and WAVAX are moving differently
Around $4.6 million of native AVAX left exchange wallets over the latest seven days. WAVAX went the other way. Around $12.3 million moved into exchanges, while Top PnL wallets reduced their WAVAX positions by roughly $2.2 million.
Native AVAX is moving away from exchanges while WAVAX is moving toward them. At the same time, WAVAX remains extremely active on DEXs. For now, it looks more like capital moving around the ecosystem than everyone taking the same position.
Fresh wallets are still bringing money in
Fresh wallets added approximately $20.8 million in AVAX over seven days. Another $16.3 million went into WAVAX. Those are meaningful inflows, but both were below their normal levels. AVAX was running at around 0.6x its average flow, while WAVAX was around 0.4x.
New wallets are participating, just not at an unusually high rate. There is fresh capital coming in, but this does not look like another sudden wave of adoption.
BTC.b is still doing real volume
BTC.b continues to be one of the more active parts of Avalanche DeFi. It recorded around $238.8 million in DEX volume over 30 days, with approximately $1.3 million in net flow.
Over the latest seven days, BTC.b generated another $60.9 million in volume, with $31.5 million in buys and $29.4 million in sells.
There is no major imbalance between buyers and sellers. It is simply an active market.
Bitcoin liquidity gives Avalanche another source of capital beyond AVAX and stablecoins, and BTC.b is still moving through the ecosystem rather than simply sitting in wallets.
sAVAX looks steady
sAVAX has around 16,609 holders, approximately $169.8 million in market cap, and roughly $2.2 million in liquidity. Seven-day volume was around $743,000, with approximately $424,000 in buys compared with $319,000 in sells.
There is no obvious new staking surge here.
